title: 第二十四章 浮生若梦第二十五章 浮生若梦二
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄

她凝望着对面几人，心底不由泛起一丝复杂，希望是她想多了。
最终，两队人马商议决定，暂且在此休整一夜，双方轮流派遣弟子值守，只待天明便分头进入秘境。
天色渐晚，火光摇曳间，谢清猗瞥见不远处的千沐妍与司楚白。
两人之间仿佛隔着一层无形的壁障，司楚白负手而立，侧脸线条紧绷，似乎在极力隐忍着某种情绪。
而千沐妍则脸色苍白，微微垂着头，单薄的身影在夜色中轻轻颤抖，显然是又在无声垂泪。
司楚白周身气场又冷了几分，不理会身旁拉着他袖摆默默垂泪的千沐妍，他眉心紧锁，唇线紧抿，恰在此时，他抬眼望见不远处的谢清猗。
对面篝火后的少女一袭月白仙裙曳地，裙摆层叠如云，笼罩于暮山紫轻纱羽衣之下，裙袂飘飘，如携流风回雪，腰间仅以一条雾紫色软纱松松挽就，更衬得纤腰不盈一握，身段曼妙无极。
如瀑青丝半绾成髻，余下墨发翩垂至腰际，映得那胜雪的肌肤愈发剔透，玉雕雪琢的容颜愈发绝美出尘。
司楚白眸光微颤，那抹身姿透着火光映在他黑眸里，此刻对方正对他微微弯起唇角，那一笑，恍若明珠溢彩，琉璃生辉，他微微收紧手指。
千沐妍侧头顺着司楚白的目光望去，见他竟一瞬不瞬地凝视着远处的谢清猗，眸中是她从未见过的专注。
她不由自主地掐紧了手心中对方袖摆，银白的法袍在她手中被揉皱。她紧咬下唇瞪着对方，一抹狠戾在她眼中闪过。
也不知这两人此刻又在演绎哪一出戏码，谢清猗心中暗念，恰在此时，司楚白的目光扫了过来，她可不是偷看哈，神情不变，嘴角几不可察地翘起，回以一个恰到好处的礼貌微笑，心念道，‘男主请别关注我。’
随即翩然转身，在旁边的大石头坐下，闭目凝神，打坐调息，将身后那里人的目光全然无视掉。
天光破晓，青灰色的天幕上还有残星几点，明灭不定。
谢清猗自入定中醒来，眸中映入一片弥漫的晨雾，浓白的雾气缠绕着奇峰怪石，为整座句余山披上了一层神秘的薄纱。
众人收拾停当，立即开始搜寻秘境入口，然而放眼望去，四下里尽是嶙峋怪石，阴沉的天光，将整座山体都笼罩在一片灰黑的死寂之中。
她跟在司楚白与千沐妍身后，看着前方二人背影，想到句余山秘境即便在开放之时，两侧入口亦会是虚实交替，真假变幻，时开时关，毫无规律可言，极大地增加了探寻的难度，也不知他们何时才能找到。
不知转了多少圈，又是布阵又是掐算，司楚白才带领着剩余弟子耗费良久，才捕捉到那稍纵即逝的契机，成功踏入句余山秘境之中。
谢清猗看着眼前那如碧波荡开般的秘境入口，心脏跳动快了几分，天呐～她居然进了修仙界传说中的秘境，这太奇幻了～

随着众人进入，她好奇地打量着四周，见内部竟与句余山的荒凉死寂有天差地别，只觉恍若一步踏入了另一方天地。
放眼望去，云蒸霞蔚，远处仙雾缭绕间点缀着几座悬浮的玲珑小岛，其下碧湖如镜，水面氤氲着一层轻薄水汽。
四周岸芷汀兰，遍地开满了鸢尾花，沁人心脾的幽香弥漫在空气中，空中的光晕都流光溢彩，梦幻之极，犹如仙境，她心中再次感叹，果真是玄幻世界才有的景象。
正当众人沉醉于眼前美景时，她余光瞥见千沐妍此刻正楚楚可怜地拉住司楚白的手腕，声音带着哽咽，低低抽泣起来：“楚白师兄，你和我说句话吧，你都一天没理我了……”
“我保证后面秘境一定不会再像毒瘴林那般了……”千沐妍见对方冷着脸不看自己，眼眶彻底红了，“别和我生气……”
司楚白眉心紧促，面容紧绷，目光并未落在她身上，只是疏离而坚定地将自己的手抽了回来，语气平淡得听不出半分情绪：“此刻不是说这些的时候。”
谢清猗在一旁听得目瞪口呆，心中暗道，女主你不看看自己在哪里，这是危机四伏的秘境，你居然满脑子只想着谈情说爱？
她控制不住的悄悄翻了个白眼，像司楚白这种天塌下来都想着先搞事业的男人，能吃得下你这一套吗？女主你可长点心，换换套路呀～
看着眼前不顾其他弟子的两人，她微微一叹，现在更加怀疑，她居然不记得书中有这么清晰的描写，难道她真的看得太粗糙了？她穿的这本书真的是男频文吗？

She stared at the people opposite her, feeling a little complicated in her heart, hoping that she was overthinking.
In the end, the two teams discussed and decided to rest here for the night. Both sides took turns sending disciples to guard the place, and they would separately enter the secret realm at dawn.
It was getting late, and as the firelight flickered, Xie Qingyi caught a glimpse of Qian Muyan and Si Chubai not far away.
There seemed to be an invisible barrier between the two of them. Si Chubai stood with his hands behind his hands, his face tense, as if he was trying his best to suppress some emotion.
Qian Muyan's face was pale, her head hung slightly, her thin figure trembling slightly in the night, obviously crying silently again.
Si Chubai's aura became a little colder. He ignored Qian Muyan who was holding his sleeves and weeping silently. He frowned and pursed his lips. At this moment, he raised his eyes and saw Xie Qingyi not far away.
The girl behind the bonfire opposite is wearing a moon-white fairy skirt that is trailing to the ground. The skirt is layered like clouds, shrouded under the purple gauze feather coat of Dushan Mountain. The skirts are fluttering, like carrying the wind back to the snow. Her waist is only loosely held by a piece of mist purple soft gauze, which makes her waist slimmer and slimmer. Her figure is extremely graceful.
The black silk hair is half tied into a bun like a waterfall, and the remaining black hair hangs down to the waist, making the snow-skinned skin become more and more translucent, and the jade-carved and snow-carved face becomes even more beautiful.
Si Chubai's eyes trembled slightly, and the figure was reflected in his black eyes with firelight. At this moment, the other party was slightly curling the corners of his lips towards him. That smile was like a pearl overflowing with color and glaze shining brightly. He tightened his fingers slightly.
Qian Muyan turned her head and followed Si Chubai's gaze, and saw that he was staring at Xie Qingyi in the distance for an instant, with a focus she had never seen in his eyes.
She couldn't help but tighten the sleeves of the other party's sleeves in her hands, and the silver robe was crumpled in her hands. She bit her lower lip and stared at the other person, a trace of cruelty flashing in her eyes.
I don't know what drama the two of them are acting out at the moment, Xie Qingyi thought to himself, but at this moment, Si Chubai's eyes glanced over, she was not peeking, her expression remained unchanged, the corners of her mouth were raised almost imperceptibly, and she responded with a polite smile that was just right, thinking, 'Master, please don't pay attention to me. ’
Then he turned around gracefully, sat down on the big stone next to him, closed his eyes and concentrated, meditated and adjusted his breath, completely ignoring the eyes of the people behind him.
The sky was breaking at dawn, and there were a few remaining stars on the blue-gray sky, which were flickering on and off.
Xie Qingyi woke up from his trance, and saw a diffuse morning mist in his eyes. The thick white mist wrapped around the strange peaks and rocks, covering the entire Juyu Mountain with a mysterious veil.
Everyone packed up and immediately began to search for the entrance to the secret realm. However, looking around, they saw jagged and strange rocks everywhere, and the gloomy sky shrouded the entire mountain in a gray-black silence.
She followed Si Chubai and Qian Muyan and looked at the backs of the two people in front of them. She thought that even when Juyu Mountain's secret realm was open, the entrances on both sides would alternate between false and true, real and false, opening and closing at times, without any rules, which greatly increased the difficulty of exploration, and she didn't know when they would find it.
After countless turns, formations and calculations, Si Chubai led the remaining disciples and spent a long time before seizing the fleeting opportunity and successfully entering the secret realm of Juyu Mountain.
Xie Qingyi looked at the entrance to the secret realm in front of her, which was like blue waves. Her heart beat a little faster. Oh my god, she actually entered the legendary secret realm in the world of immortality. This is so magical~
As everyone entered, she looked around curiously, and saw that the interior was completely different from the desolate silence of Juyu Mountain, and she felt as if she had stepped into another world.
Looking around, the clouds are steaming and the clouds are shining brightly. In the distance, there are several floating exquisite islands dotted with fairy mist. The blue lake below is like a mirror, and the water is covered with a thin layer of water vapor.
Surrounded by orchids, the ground was full of irises. The refreshing fragrance filled the air, and the halo in the air was brilliant and dreamy. It was like a fairyland. She sighed again in her heart, it was really a scene only in the fantasy world.Just as everyone was intoxicated with the beautiful scenery in front of them, she caught a glimpse of Qian Muyan holding Si Chubai's wrist pitifully at the moment, her voice choked with sobs, "Senior Brother Chu Bai, please talk to me, you have ignored me for the whole day..."
"I promise that the secret realm in the back will not be like the Poisonous Miasma Forest..." Qian Muyan's eyes turned completely red when she saw the other party's cold face and not looking at her, "Don't be angry with me..."
Si Chubai's eyebrows were furrowed and his face was tense. His eyes did not fall on her, but he pulled his hand back distantly and firmly. His tone was so calm that no emotion could be heard: "Now is not the time to talk about this."
Xie Qingyi was stunned when he heard this, and thought to himself, heroine, don't you look at where you are, this is a secret realm full of dangers, and all you can think about is falling in love?
She couldn't help but rolled her eyes quietly. Can a man like Si Chubai, who thinks about his career first even if the sky falls, be able to tolerate this? Hostess, please be more careful and change your routine~
Looking at the two people in front of her who ignored the other disciples, she sighed slightly, and now she was even more suspicious. She didn't remember such a clear description in the book. Could it be that her reading was too rough? Is the book she is wearing really a male video?
